That sounds exhausting. Before you make a decision tomorrow, can we talk tonight and figure out what’s making things unbearable—your workload, your manager, or the job itself? You don’t have to resign impulsively, but you also don’t have to keep suffering indefinitely. If you can, take a day, review your finances and options, and make a plan that protects you.

## 2

I understand why some images can look suspicious, especially when they’re edited, compressed, or produced from multiple data sources. But the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend on one photograph: ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible at different latitudes, lunar eclipses show Earth’s curved shadow, and time zones and satellite communications work exactly as a globe model predicts. These observations come from many independent sources, including amateur observers, not just space agencies.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than red light because blue has shorter waves. So when you look away from the Sun, much of the light reaching your eyes is scattered blue light, making the sky appear blue. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, scattering away much of the blue and leaving more red and orange.

雨落在深夜的城市里，细密而连续，像一层看不见的帘子。路灯被水汽晕开，昏黄的光铺在积水上，随着车轮驶过，碎成一片片颤动的倒影。屋檐滴水有节奏地敲着窗台，远处偶尔传来汽车驶过湿路的声响。街上行人很少，伞面下的身影匆匆掠过。空气里混着泥土、树叶和潮湿柏油的气味，整座城市仿佛暂时放低了声音，只剩雨替它呼吸。
